texts: 5 (e): An ArcRotateCamera puts its eye at target + radius * (cos(alpha)*sin(beta), cos(beta), sin(alpha)*sin(beta)) in its parent's space, using 0.0001 for sin(beta) when it is exactly 0. The camera looks at target with up (0,1,0). alpha and beta stay as written until setCameraLimits runs.

10 (a): attachControl's keyboard: true is ignored unless enableArcRotateKeyboardControls() ran first. Keys are heard on the canvas (tabIndex made 0 if no tabindex attribute); held arrows add 1/angularSensitivity (default 100) per frame. While Meta is held, no key adds anything.

11 (a): With Ctrl held, and Alt or not, held arrows add 1/panningSensitivity instead, to inertialPanningX/Y. With no modifier or with Ctrl, each step is divided by sqrt(2) while one arrow on each axis is held; with Alt and no Ctrl, it is never divided.

15 (b): resolveCameraViewport counts camera.viewport.y from the bottom but returns y from the top: {x:0,y:0,width:0.5,height:0.5} on 800x600 gives {x:0,y:300,width:400,height:300}. Its edges are clamped to the canvas: {x:-0.5,width:1} gives width 400. getEffectiveAspectRatio and _applyCameraViewport clamp nothing.

38 (c): getProjectionMatrix does not apply camera.viewport; pass getEffectiveAspectRatio(camera, width, height) as the aspect to match what is rendered. That ratio is width/height * viewport.width/viewport.height, or width/height with no viewport, unrounded, and differs from resolveCameraViewport's when that clamps an edge.

39 (d): An edit to a field of GeospatialCamera.limits applies at the next yaw/pitch/radius write that changes the value, or at any center assignment (cam.center = cam.center works). A new object assigned to limits is never used by the camera's clamps. limits.pitchDisabledRadiusScale = null allows full pitch at any radius.

40 (f): setGeospatialOrientation always wraps yaw and pitch to [-PI, PI) and applies the camera's limits again, even when given no field; an omitted or null field keeps its current value. The yaw, pitch and radius setters do nothing when the value written equals the stored, wrapped and clamped value.

44 (g): attachFreeControl's drag starts on a pointerdown with button 0, 1 or 2 of any pointerType and ends on any pointerup, not on pointercancel. Each pointermove in it, whatever its buttons, pointerType or pointerId, turns by its clientX and clientY change divided by angularSensitivity; movementX and movementY are not read.
